idea-plugin.name: Polar Night Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A deep navy dark theme with rich but muted syntax colors, designed for focused, distraction-free coding sessions.

Features:
  • Deep navy background — easy on eyes for long sessions
  • Rich but desaturated palette: sage green, soft amber, lavender, pale blue
  • Full UI coverage: editor, tool windows, terminal, diff, debugger, VCS log
  • Comprehensive syntax support: Java, Kotlin, Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust, CSS, HTML, XML, JSON, YAML, Markdown
  • Italic comments for visual hierarchy
